verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's deployed scanners (hosted or self-hosted) continuously monitor Git, Jira, Slack, Confluence and other sources in the background. They track key remediation status and route alerts to Slack, Jira, email or webhooks without manual runs, and git hooks apply scans automatically across all repos. However, the automation is limited to fixed secret-scanning and alerting, and it is framed as an Enterprise offering rather than user-defined autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger configuration, user-defined automation workflows beyond scan-and-alert, clarity on availability in open source, and independent/hands-on corroboration of background operation.
